ablations.title: Frame rate

rows.variant: frames thinned by the old pacer (4-core Kaggle T4)

ablations.takeaway: Tracking at 10 Hz matters: when the old pacer dropped frames to save time, tracks broke and a fifth of the score went. The pacer now thins only when a run would overrun.
ablations.source: measured: evaluate.py on predictions_samples.json and runs/kaggle_t4_official.json (SPEC §12.56)

ablations.title: Occlusion guard for line crossings
ablations.takeaway: A bus half hidden behind another has a box that ends at the other bus's roof; its footprint slid across a solid line. Footprints a nearer vehicle covers no longer count.
ablations.source: measured: Part A on the track caches, with and without the guard (SPEC §12.55)

ablations.title: Part B: what counts as a conflict
ablations.metric: false alarms in 7.4 min of accident-free traffic

rows.variant: bumper gaps, lane-aware path, emergency braking needed

ablations.takeaway: Queues closing up, side-by-side lanes and far-away jitter all looked like collision courses. A conflict now has to need emergency braking, measured where the camera resolves it.
ablations.source: recorded: SPEC §12.47 (the old risk features no longer exist)

ablations.title: failure_to_yield: what 'on the crossing' means
ablations.metric: false positives on the dev videos

rows.variant: on its roadway part, in the vehicle's path, cars/buses/trucks only

ablations.takeaway: The zebras' ends lie on the kerb and the island, where people wait all day.

ablations.title: near_miss: trigger
ablations.metric: false near misses on the dev videos (the samples contain none)

rows.variant: Part B's conflict test + the mover's own braking

ablations.takeaway: Better, but 4 false events in 7.4 min with no real near miss to measure recall on: the class stays off rather than risk adding a zero class to the score.

ablations.title: Rejected: jaywalking only in the near field

rows.variant: only where 1 px <= 8 cm of road

ablations.takeaway: It split a long merged event but lost a real one; people waiting in the kerb lane are on the road by the definition, so the rule was kept as it is.
